meta: Connect your inbox so emails and replies are saved on the right contact record. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Email sync that keeps every conversation in one place
overview: We connect your team's inboxes to your CRM, so emails sent and received appear on the right contact and deal without anyone copying them over. We set sharing rules for who can see what, add tracking for opens only where you want it, and test with real sample emails. You also receive a simple guide for adding the CRM address to cc or bcc. Private mail stays private, as agreed with each user.

faq: Does it work with Gmail and Outlook?
Yes. Gmail, Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 or Outlook are the usual cases, and most CRMs connect to them. Tell us which provider you use and we check that your CRM supports it before we start.
Will the CRM see all my personal email?
No. We set the sync to log only emails with people in your CRM, and you can choose to keep other messages out. Each user approves their own connection, so nobody is connected without knowing.
Open tracking is optional and set up only on request in Premium. Some countries require notice for tracking, so we recommend telling contacts, and we follow your CRM's own rules for it.
Do I need a paid CRM plan?
Some CRMs limit email sync to paid plans. We check this at the start and tell you which plan you need. The plan fee goes to the CRM company, and our price covers the connection work.
